items.source: Construct a new DefaultCacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate using the supplied ContextCache and the default or user-configured context failure threshold.
items.translation: 使用提供的ContextCache以及默认或用户配置的上下文失败阈值，构建一个新的DefaultCacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate。

items.source: Default implementation of the ContextCache API.
items.translation: 默认实现ContextCacheAPI。

items.source: Get the ContextCache used by this context loader delegate.
